description: Fast space ops view: DB-level used%/free/size + VLF hotspots. File-level detail is collapsed (expand to load). Avoids raw per-file timeseries.

targets.expr: count(max by (instance, db) (mssql_database_space_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"}) >= 85) or vector(0)
count(max by (instance, db) (mssql_database_space_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"}) >= 95) or vector(0)

count((mssql_database_space_growth_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"} > 0 < 64) unless on(instance, db, file_id, logical_name, type_desc, physical_name) (mssql_database_space_is_percent_growth{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"} == 1)) or vector(0)
topk(15, max by (instance, db) (mssql_database_space_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"}))
topk(15, count by (instance) (max by (instance, db) (mssql_database_space_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"}) >= 85))
topk(15, sum by (instance, db) (mssql_database_space_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"}))
topk(15, max by (instance, db) (mssql_database_space_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"}))
bottomk(15, sum by (instance, db) (mssql_database_space_free_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"}))
topk(15, sum by (instance, db) (mssql_database_space_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"}))
count by (instance) (max by (instance, db) (mssql_database_space_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", type_desc=~"${type_desc:regex}"}) >= 85)
